nodes.label: RLS Lockdown Migration
nodes.rationale: Drops every USING(true) policy so all reads/writes require the authenticated role and anon privileges are revoked, closing the actively-exploitable open-RLS hole.

nodes.label: Password Hash Wipe Migration
nodes.rationale: Nulls password_hash and forces reset for every consultant row to remove reversible manager/password digests leaked while RLS was open.

nodes.label: Admin Backdoor Removal (Login.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Deletes the admin/manager guaranteed-login fallback so authentication now requires a matching consultant record plus a valid hash.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Hash Removal (App.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Removes embedded SHA-256 seed hashes and hardcoded admin email so credentials are no longer committed-readable; hashes are computed at runtime only for local-mode demo.

nodes.label: Phase 2: Real Authentication + Role-Based Authorization
nodes.rationale: Replaces client-only SHA-256 auth with Supabase Auth end-to-end, adds a profiles table keyed by auth.uid() holding role + tier, and rewrites RLS to be role-aware so only superusers can grant admin power.
